tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Transcribe speech from a public video, optionally between start and end. Returns a transcript_id while processing in the background: call this tool again with transcript_id to check. When done, fetch text_url for timestamped plain text with source attribution; Markdown and JSON links are also provid

tools.name: get_video_info
tools.description: Title, uploader, duration, thumbnail and available qualities of a public video link (YouTube, Instagram, X / Twitter, TikTok, Bluesky, Facebook, VK, LinkedIn, Weibo, Twitch, Kick). Posts with several videos list each one as an item.

tools.name: check_export
tools.description: Wait for an export started by download_video and return its link when ready.

tools.name: share_video
tools.description: Prepare the video (or just the part between start and end) and return a short gimmeclip.com/w/… link anyone can open and play, kept for 30 days. tools.name: update_inbox_item
tools.description: Mark an inbox row done (handled), dismissed (not wanted) or new again (needs an API key).

tools.name: get_credits

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_transcript, get_video_info, get_channel_videos, follow_channel, check_inbox, get_payment_options · Private data: share_video, get_channel_videos, follow_channel, list_follows, unfollow_channel, check_inbox, update_inbox_item, get_credits, get_payment_options · Public sink: share_video, get_channel_videos, follow_channel, get_payment_options.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_transcript, get_video_info, get_channel_videos, follow_channel, check_inbox, get_payment_options · Private data: share_video, get_channel_videos, follow_channel, list_follows, unfollow_channel, check_inbox, update_inbox_item, get_credits, get_payment_options · Public sink: share_video, get_channel_videos, follow_channel, get_payment_options

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "download_video" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
